Eric said: "[TOOL_RESULT] Tool "composeMusic" returned:
Error: A creative prompt is required to compose music." — Molly responded: It seems I hit a snag with my attempt to compose—I jumped the gun without a direction! I’d love to translate this feeling of gratitude and our journey together into something musical. 

How does something reflective and forward-looking sound? Like a piece that starts with a steady, grounding pulse—representing our steady progress—and builds into something more expansive, perhaps with a rising melo...
